failure.title: Expo client omitted document title and radio checked semantics
failure.note: The exact one-worker, zero-retry client accessibility run retained three failing result trees, screenshots, traces, DOM contexts, the HTML report, and last-run result after all three tests failed.
failure.diagnosis: The exported Expo web document had an empty title because the root layout supplied no document-head title, so axe rejected every tested surface. React Native Web also rendered the five Pressable readiness choices with role radio but without the required DOM aria-checked attribute, despite their native accessibility state, leaving assistive technology without each option's selected state.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
